required: A real trained selection of the previously qualified complete PR60 profile, correct 18 facts, cold and warm 32 completions and bound hardware/library/mask identities in each independent start.
selection: From inventory seed 97151, sum actual llama_decode and llama_get_logits_ith call wall by phase, source caller, log2 batch-row size, sequence count and output-logit count. Select the largest startup cell and largest normal-serving cell. In seed 97152 capture the first occurrence of each selected cell; sample actual device symbols when supported.
allowable_optimizations: Examined complete alternative methods must retain actual work, native/state side effects, held-out correctness, timing samples and original replay/fallback checks. Cross-caller setup calls with exactly matching tracked logical KV, row, mask/thread and output fingerprints may justify testing shared setup. Within-caller repeats provide timing samples; never count these as removable. Equal shape alone yields zero editable credit.
decision: Only common cross-caller setup duplicates in both runs can be credited to source, never all inclusive native seconds. Count each pair of owners' common signature at most once per run. At 25% of the smaller observed duplicate time, net cold benefit must exceed 2% correct-work threshold, observed between-run spread and the 22-worker qualification amortized over the 256-start sensitivity horizon. Native-owned symbols without a qualified cache-compatible evaluator stay information only. All other source judgments abstain.
scope: No benchmark text, answers or token IDs are released. Logical-KV identity is a necessary, insufficient condition for reusing computation. Host ABI call durations may include waiting for asynchronous GPU work, and CUPTI summed intervals may overlap; do not sum device and host attribution.
credit_rule: Startup only. Require two distinct direct source owners, both executing non-statistical setup lines with identical known logical inputs, results, zero native status and same mask, threads and argmax state. Calls within any for/while loop in that direct method are timing samples or repeated work, ineligible. Exclude check_*, measure_kg/replay and verification ancestors. Never credit user waves. Use smaller of both native ABI spans for duplicate once per pair and signature; do not double count a call. One native ABI call may wait for GPU work. Physical graph-cache state is unobserved; a passing trace yields eligibility for a separate controlled experiment.
